title: Administration Assistant
description:
Administrative Assistant

My client is a well-established manufacturing business seeking an Administration & Customer Service Assistant to join their busy office team. This varied role will involve supporting customer order processing, maintaining accurate records, liaising with internal departments, and providing excellent customer service via telephone and email.

This opportunity would suit someone at the earlier stages of their career who is keen to develop within an administrative and customer-focused position, as well as individuals looking to build upon existing office experience. Training will be provided, with genuine opportunities for ongoing development and progression within the business.

The successful candidate will be highly organised, have strong attention to detail, and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment where communication and teamwork are key. Previous administration, customer service, or order processing experience would be advantageous, although attitude, reliability, and a willingness to learn are equally important.

Peterborough, Fengate

Salary: 25,610,65

Working Hours
- Full-time position
- Monday to Friday
- 9:00am - 5:15pm
- Office-based

Benefits
- Shift allowance for applicable late-shift hours.
- Company pension.
- Free on-site parking.
- Staff canteen.
- Discounted or free food.
- Company events and social activities.
- Training and development opportunities.

Overview

We are seeking a highly organised and detail-focused Administrative Assistant to support a busy office environment and day-to-day operational activities. This position plays a key role in ensuring customer orders are processed accurately, information is maintained effectively, and communication flows smoothly between customers, purchasing teams, and operational departments.

Working closely with both internal teams and external customers, the successful candidate will contribute to efficient order management, product administration, and production support processes.

Key Responsibilities

Order Processing & Administration
- Receive and accurately process customer orders.
- Maintain accurate, organised, and up-to-date order records.
- Create and maintain product information within internal systems.
- Prepare delivery notes and associated documentation to support the timely dispatch of orders.
- Ensure all order-related information is recorded correctly and readily accessible.
- Support general administrative activities as required.

Purchasing & Operational Support
- Work closely with purchasing teams, internal buyers to ensure materials required for customer orders are sourced in a timely manner.
- Record and monitor expected delivery dates for incoming materials.
- Track supplier lead times and highlight any potential delays.
- Liaise with relevant departments regarding material availability and order progress.
- Provide accurate information to support production planning and scheduling activities.

Customer & Internal Communication
- Handle customer enquiries via telephone and email.
- Provide updates relating to orders, deliveries, and general enquiries.
- Build and maintain positive relationships with customers.
- Communicate effectively with colleagues across various departments to help ensure the smooth progression of customer orders.
- Escalate issues appropriately and support problem resolution where required.

Skills & Experience

Essential
- Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
- Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to administration.
- Effective verbal and written communication skills.
- Professional and confident telephone and email manner.
- Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build positive working relationships.
- Ability to prioritise workload and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
- Capable of working independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
- Proactive and solution-focused approach.

Desirable
- Previous experience within an administrative, customer service, or order processing role.
- Competent user of Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
- Experience working within a manufacturing, engineering, production, or supply chain environment.
- Understanding of material lead times, production scheduling, and order fulfilment processes.
- Experience using ERP, business management, or order processing systems.

The Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will be reliable, organised, and approachable, with a strong commitment to accuracy and efficiency. They will be comfortable managing a varied workload, communicating with customers daily, and ensuring information is kept current and accurate.

Previous experience supporting operational or manufacturing environments would be advantageous, particularly where customer orders, supply chain coordination, and production-related administration have formed part of the role.

Above all, a positive attitude, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage priorities effectively are essential for success in this position.

title: Finance & Accounts Coordinator
description:
Finance & Accounts Coordinator

Looking for a finance role that offers more variety and responsibility than traditional accounts administration?

This is an opportunity to join an established and growing business in a broad finance position, taking responsibility for a varied range of accounting and financial administration activities.

This position will see you involved in the day-to-day financial operations of the business, covering everything from purchase and sales ledger through to reconciliations, credit control, VAT and month-end support.

It's a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working across different areas of finance, takes pride in accuracy and is confident managing their own workload.

What will you be responsible for?
- Accounts Management: Handling supplier invoices, customer billing, payment applications and resolving account queries.
- Financial Control: Managing bank and credit card reconciliations, monitoring outstanding customer payments and supporting cash flow
- Project & Cost Tracking: Recording costs against jobs, monitoring material expenditure and helping maintain accurate project and stock information
- Compliance & Reporting: Dealing with CIS requirements, VAT returns and month-end activities, including journals, accruals and prepayments.

What experience will you need?

We're looking for someone with a solid grounding in accounts or finance who is comfortable working across multiple areas of a finance function.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant or similar position.
- Good working knowledge of purchase and sales ledger processes.
- Experience with UK VAT requirements, including CIS and Domestic Reverse Charge VAT.
- Confidence completing bank and credit card reconciliations.
- Experience using accounting software, ideally Sage 50.
- Strong Excel skills, including the ability to work with VLOOKUPs and Pivot Tables.
- Excellent numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
- The ability to manage competing deadlines and work independently.
- Confident communication skills when dealing with suppliers, customers and colleagues.

Qualifications & Additional Experience

An AAT Level 2 or Level 3 qualification, or someone currently studying towards AAT, would be welcomed.

Experience with ERP or MRP systems, stock control, project costing or manufacturing accounts would also be beneficial.

However, relevant practical experience and a good understanding of financial processes are equally important.

The Opportunity

You'll be joining an established business where the finance function plays an important part in supporting operational and commercial activity.

The breadth of the position offers exposure to several areas of accounting, providing an excellent opportunity for someone looking to consolidate their existing experience and continue developing their finance career.

Interested?

If you have experience across accounts or finance and are looking for a varied position where you can take ownership of a broad range of responsibilities, we'd be keen to hear from you.

title: Purchasing & Supply Chain Coordinator
description:
Purchasing & Supply Chain Coordinator

Looking to take the next step in your purchasing career?

If you enjoy working with suppliers, negotiating prices, keeping orders on track and making sure a business has the materials it needs, this could be an excellent opportunity to broaden your purchasing experience.

We're recruiting a Purchasing & Supply Chain Coordinator for an established and growing business.

This is a varied, hands-on position where you'll have involvement in the full purchasing process, from sourcing materials and comparing supplier quotations through to placing orders, managing deliveries and resolving supply issues.

You'll work closely with colleagues across the business, playing an important part in keeping production and projects running smoothly. It's a role that offers more than simply processing purchase orders, with opportunities to develop your commercial understanding and build valuable supplier relationships.

What will your day involve?

No two days are likely to be quite the same, but your responsibilities will include:
- Sourcing and buying: Identifying suppliers, obtaining quotations, comparing prices and negotiating favourable purchasing terms for materials, components and external services.
- Managing suppliers: Building relationships with suppliers, discussing pricing and availability, confirming orders and maintaining reliable supply.
- Keeping things moving: Tracking outstanding orders, chasing deliveries and resolving issues before they impact production schedules or project deadlines.
- Materials coordination: Monitoring stock levels, identifying replenishment requirements and helping ensure the right materials are available when needed.
- Commercial control: Reviewing purchasing costs, keeping expenditure in line with agreed budgets and identifying opportunities to improve value and reduce waste.
- Problem solving: Investigating delivery, quality, pricing and invoice discrepancies, working with suppliers and internal colleagues to find practical solutions.
- Purchasing administration: Maintaining accurate purchase orders, supplier records, pricing information and reporting on purchasing activity.

What will you bring?

We're looking for someone who understands the importance of getting purchasing right. Someone organised, commercially aware and comfortable dealing with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Ideally, you'll have:
- Previous experience in purchasing, procurement, buying or purchasing administration.
- Experience obtaining and comparing supplier quotations.
- Confidence communicating with suppliers and managing order enquiries.
- An understanding of purchase orders, delivery schedules and stock requirements.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Experience using purchasing, stock management or ERP systems.

Knowledge of engineering materials, MRP/ERP systems or a CIPS qualification would be an added bonus.

Why consider this opportunity?

This is an opportunity to join an established business where purchasing plays an important role in day-to-day operations.

You'll gain exposure to a broad range of purchasing activities, work with suppliers and internal departments, and have the opportunity to develop your commercial and procurement knowledge.

Interested?

If you're currently working in purchasing, buying administration or procurement and are looking for a role offering variety, responsibility and the opportunity to develop your experience, we'd love to hear from you.
